text: My daily routine is simple but well organized. I usually wake up at seven o'clock and start my morning with a glass of water and a healthy breakfast. After that, I get ready and begin work at nine. I work until five in the afternoon, with a short lunch break in between. Around six, I go to the gym or take a long walk in the park because exercise helps me relax. In the evening, I cook dinner, watch a series, or read a book. I try to go to bed before eleven. Staying consistent with this routine gives me energy and keeps me focused.
